title: Battle of Ashar Creek
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Ashar Creek", at revision 1378382106, opens: "The Battle of Ashar Creek was a prolonged naval engagement in Spring of 1775 between the Zand Dynasty of Iran, aided by the Banu Ka'b and Shaykh of Bushehr, against the Ottoman Mamluk-held Iraq and their British aides. A chain boom had been constructed over the Shatt al-Arab to inhibit a naval blockade of Basra. The Persians made many attempts both to probe and break through, and were held up for half a month until the British chain was broken and the Persians were subsequently able to extend their blockade over the entire city." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q141663042, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1775 naval battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
